rationale: Material prompt requirement: Create an end-to-end go-to-market plan for our new developer product. Source anchor "# Sprint Retro Facilitator": This skill offers a relevant planning or retrospective component, but it does not provide the complete end-to-end go-to-market plan and requested commercial and launch deliverables.. On that source-visible basis, source boundary conflicts with a material prompt constraint Boundary noted in the sealed assessment: Commercial-motion choice, positioning and message hierarchy, launch brief, channel plan, outreach kit, readiness checklist, measurement plan, and risks.
